stem: Meridian Labs is selecting a managed relational engine for rich JSON queries and extension-heavy analytic SQL workloads.

choices.text: Choose MySQL to prioritize broad tool compatibility and simpler transactional patterns.
Choose MariaDB to maximize compatibility with MySQL-oriented workflows.
Choose PostgreSQL for advanced JSON handling, complex queries, and extension support.
Choose MySQL with read replicas to substitute for extension requirements.

rationale: The lesson discriminator maps PostgreSQL to advanced JSON handling, complex queries, and custom extensions. MySQL and MariaDB are strong compatibility-focused choices for simpler transactional profiles, but they are not the best fit for this stated feature set. Adding read replicas does not replace extension and query-capability requirements.
